  (0,0) → (1,0) → (1,1) → (2,1) → (3,1) → (3,2) → (3,3)  
  - Costs: R, R, R, R, R, G (total: 5R, 1G)

**What can you offer that gets me more? You have lots of B, but ZERO R.**  
You, in turn, can only move on B and G tiles solo, since you have no R.  
You need me to cover ALL of your R steps to goal.
